settings.visualStyle: Grounded cinematic first-person Stalingrad realism, November 1942. Soviet Red Army POV, shattered brick interiors, basement passages, cold Volga wind, snow dust, soot, smoke and exhausted human movement. Build tension through silence, confined spaces, sound direction and sudden short movement rather than constant combat.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 scenes x 8 seconds. No dialogue, no narration, no intelligible speech. POV faction is Soviet Red Army for the whole episode; nearby friendlies remain Soviet, while German or Axis forces appear only as clearly separated opposing movement, distant silhouettes, street frontage or firing direction. Weapon visibility varies naturally and is often lowered, slung, resting or off-frame during exploration, map reading, fire warming and observation. Use cinematic reveals without copying specific film shots.
settings.customVisualStyle: Photorealistic first-person urban war reenactment with cold blue-gray light, brick dust, frost, dim firelight, human body weight, cautious steps, natural head turns, long stillness and sudden short motion.

movie.storyTitle: WWII Soldier POV EP02 — Stalingrad: The Encirclement Begins
movie.storySummary: A fictional Soviet rifleman survives a shattered Stalingrad sector during the opening days of Operation Uranus, moving through ruins, waiting in cold positions and sensing the larger battle changing beyond the city.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Make the viewer feel trapped inside Stalingrad as one Soviet rifleman. Alternate confined exploration, silent waiting, short exposed movement, human recovery and distant strategic change. The rifle should not dominate every frame: it may be slung, resting beside a wall, partly visible or absent while the soldier explores a room, touches frozen brick, warms hands, studies a map or looks over the Volga. Nearby soldiers are Soviet. Enemy presence must remain visually and spatially separate. No dialogue or narrator.

scenes.title: Cold Factory Dawn
scenes.description: The soldier wakes in a ruined factory position.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier sits up slowly and rubs numb gloved hands while the rifle rests against broken machinery.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person seated view, Soviet winter sleeves and gloved hands close to camera, Mosin-Nagant resting off to one side, frost on broken window edges, brick dust, dim dawn smoke.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow rise from seated height, first looking at hands, then toward broken windows. Audio: breath, coat fabric, wind through glass, distant artillery, no nearby firing.

scenes.title: Explore the Room
scenes.description: A quiet environmental exploration of the ruined factory interior.
scenes.actionDescription: With the rifle slung, the soldier walks slowly past broken machinery and touches a soot-covered brick wall.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person empty hand brushing red brick dust, ruined industrial equipment, hanging cable, frost, rifle not visible, Soviet comrades farther back in the same position.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow side-step exploration with a hand touching the wall. Audio: glove scraping brick, floor grit, pipe creak, breath, distant city rumble. No music.

scenes.title: Across the Courtyard
scenes.description: A short exposed movement between buildings.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier runs once across rubble and snow to a broken doorway.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person sprint at waist height, rifle held low to the side, Soviet squadmate entering the doorway ahead, shattered brick and snow underfoot.
scenes.videoPrompt: One fast run ending in a hard stop inside cover. Audio: boots on rubble, gear bounce, breath, scattered distant bursts. Brief muffled sound after debris snaps against nearby masonry.

scenes.title: Basement Passage
scenes.description: The soldier moves through a narrow basement connector.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifle remains slung while both hands steady against damp brick and a low pipe.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hands navigating a dark brick basement, candle stub, condensation on pipe, cracked plaster, Soviet boots ahead, weapon off-frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Crouched slow movement through narrow corridor. Audio: boots, water drip, fabric, pipe creak, distant artillery heavily muffled by walls.

scenes.title: Empty Street
scenes.description: The soldier watches a ruined street without firing.
scenes.actionDescription: Kneeling below a broken window, the soldier slowly rises just enough to scan the street.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person low-to-high peek over shattered brick sill, snow-dusted empty street, distant opposing building line, rifle resting below frame rather than centered.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow cautious lean upward, hold, then lower slightly. Audio: wind, loose glass, breath, far engine. No firing by POV.

scenes.title: Movement Across the Way
scenes.description: A distant enemy silhouette briefly crosses an opposing opening.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier freezes and watches one distant German silhouette cross a damaged doorway across the street, clearly separated from the Soviet position.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view from Soviet-held building toward opposite ruined facade, tiny German figure crossing far doorway, no mixed troops, Soviet glove touching brick foreground, weapon not raised into frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Nearly still camera; focus shifts from foreground frost to distant doorway movement. Audio drops quieter: wind, breath, one far burst elsewhere. No shot fired.

scenes.title: The Barrage Changes
scenes.description: The soldier notices heavier artillery far beyond the city.
scenes.actionDescription: He turns away from the street and walks to a wall breach facing the distant horizon.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view approaching broken wall, rifle slung edge only, far smoke columns beyond Stalingrad, pale winter sky and drifting snow dust.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow turn and three careful steps toward horizon reveal. Audio: deep distant rolling artillery, wind, fabric, breath.

scenes.title: Ammunition Box
scenes.description: A practical supply movement through the ruins.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier carries an ammunition box with both hands, rifle slung behind him.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hands around scratched wooden ammunition box, Soviet sleeves, rubble corridor, broken beams, weapon absent from frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Steady careful walk, box filling foreground. Audio: box rattle, rubble footsteps, wind through openings, breath.

scenes.title: Volga Opening
scenes.description: A scale reveal over the river.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier sets the box down and steps to a river-facing opening.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person empty hands on frozen masonry, broad Volga revealed through ruined structure, windblown snow dust, smoke and supply activity far below, no weapon in frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Start close on hands placing box down, then rise into wide river reveal. Audio: box thud, strong wind, canvas flap, distant engines, breath.

scenes.title: Warm the Hands
scenes.description: A deep quiet recovery beat at night.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier rests the rifle against a wall and warms both hands over a tiny protected flame.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hands over weak orange flame, rifle clearly resting off to side, soot-black brick, frost beyond shelter, no active combat in frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static seated-height shot. No gunfire nearby, no music. Audio: fire crackle, slow breathing, fabric, one distant building groan, background battlefield nearly absent.

scenes.title: Map on the Crate
scenes.description: The changing battle is understood visually through a field map.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier leans over a rough map while another Soviet hand traces movements around the city.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person map on crate, gloved Soviet hands, pencil lines, enamel cup, rifle out of frame, cold daylight through broken wall.
scenes.videoPrompt: Top-down close perspective on map, then slow lift to distant smoke through wall gap. Audio: paper rustle, pencil, wind, breath.

scenes.title: Silent Reaction
scenes.description: The unit absorbs the implication of the encirclement without words.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier looks from the map to exhausted Soviet comrades exchanging restrained silent looks.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person standing-height view of Soviet soldiers in the same ruined position, frost and soot on uniforms, no enemy nearby, weapon absent from foreground.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow pan from map edge to faces and hands of nearby comrades, then hold. Audio: room tone, fabric, breath, distant guns.

scenes.title: Back to the Window
scenes.description: Tension returns after the quieter sequence.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier picks up the rifle, walks to the window and settles it on the sill without firing.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hands lifting Mosin-Nagant from wall, then brick sill and ruined street ahead, Soviet position foreground, enemy side still opposite across street.
scenes.videoPrompt: One lift-and-step movement ending in still aiming posture. Audio: wood and metal, boots, wind, breath. No shot fired.

scenes.title: Snow Through the Roof
scenes.description: A reflective environmental beat inside the shattered building.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier lowers the rifle and looks upward through a missing roof section as fine snow drifts inside.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person upward view through broken beams to pale sky, snow falling into ruined room, glove and sleeve at frame edge, weapon lowered out of view.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow upward tilt from rubble to open sky, hold in near silence. Audio: snow hiss, wind, one distant artillery roll, breathing.

scenes.title: Winter Horizon
scenes.description: The episode ends on a broad ruined-city view.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier stands at the wall breach with rifle slung and simply watches smoke drift over the city.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person broad Stalingrad skyline under winter light, smoke columns and Volga haze, one hand resting on brick, rifle not visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow reveal into skyline and long hold. Audio: cold wind, faint distant artillery, fabric, tired breath. End unresolved.

characters.name: POV Soldier
characters.role: Fictional composite Soviet Red Army rifleman
characters.description: Anonymous Soviet Red Army first-person soldier in Stalingrad, historically plausible 1942 winter gear and Mosin-Nagant rifle.
characters.mainOutfit: Soviet winter field uniform, gloves, greatcoat elements, steel helmet where appropriate, Mosin-Nagant rifle

continuity.continuityRules: Nearby friendlies remain Soviet. Enemy German/Axis personnel appear only across clearly opposing space. Keep frost, soot, dust and fatigue continuous. Weapon may be ready, lowered, slung, resting, partial-frame or off-frame depending on the scene.

atmosphereAssets.title: Ruined Factory District
atmosphereAssets.description: Soviet-held brick factory interiors, broken machinery, frost, soot, snow dust and distant battlefield sound.
atmosphereAssets.lighting: cold winter daylight and dim firelit night

atmosphereAssets.title: Apartment Ruins
atmosphereAssets.description: Soviet position inside collapsed apartment blocks overlooking clearly separated opposing German-held frontage across streets and rubble.

atmosphereAssets.title: Volga Riverbank Sector
atmosphereAssets.description: Cold river-facing ruins, supply crates, frozen masonry, wind and smoke over the Volga.
